processing_activities.purpose: Authenticate platform users, manage sessions, secure access, and maintain account state.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Identity data, account identifiers, authentication metadata, role assignments
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Review Zitadel and infrastructure transfer positions and DPAs.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain account and access records while account is active, then follow account closure and security retention rules.
processing_activities.security_measures: OIDC, role-based access, service-to-service auth, audit logging, TLS, environment-secret controls

processing_activities.purpose: Match passengers and drivers, operate live trips, and support safety monitoring.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Location data, trip metadata, route history, driver status, passenger pickup/drop-off data
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Geolocation requires DPIA review and strict retention limits.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Live tracking retained briefly; trip records retained according to service, safety, and dispute policy.
processing_activities.security_measures: Short-lived tracking tokens, internal service auth, limited retention, operational access controls

processing_activities.purpose: Process passenger payments, driver payouts, refunds, and financial audit trails.

processing_activities.transfer_notes: Vendor and transfer position must align with finance and processor review.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain according to accounting, refund, and legal defense requirements.
processing_activities.security_measures: Processor isolation, webhook verification, least-privilege finance access, audit trails

processing_activities.purpose: Review driver documents, background checks, and qualification state before activation.

processing_activities.transfer_notes: High-risk data category requiring DPIA review and vendor controls.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain according to legal/regulatory obligations and approved retention policy.
processing_activities.security_measures: Restricted admin access, document verification workflow, status audit trail, encrypted storage

processing_activities.purpose: Store legal texts, acceptance evidence, and consent history for accountability and disputes.

dpia_records.summary: DPIA covering live trip tracking, driver monitoring, and background-check-related processing before launch.
dpia_records.scope: Compass tracking, monolith location handling, driver compliance workflows, screening processors, safety escalation flows
dpia_records.mitigating_measures: Minimize retention, restrict operational access, audit admin actions, verify vendor contracts, document lawful basis and necessity, and define incident response.
